about: The Ship AI's voice in each language: a voice id from voice-lab/voices.json (English: a macOS voice name). Listen in voice-lab/index.html, change a line here, then run python3 tools/make_vo.py --lang <code>. Marathi is SYSPIN's female voice (the clearest Marathi voice; CC-BY-4.0: credit 'SYSPIN, IISc Bangalore and ARTPARK').
